entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to process a return for an item I purchased about two months ago. It's a cycling helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. The color wasn't quite what my wife was expecting for her gift. The box is still completely sealed, it's a brand new, box unopened situation.
I understand. Let me just pull up our policy. Can I get the order number, please?

Thank you... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 60 days ago. Since it's within our 90-day return window, I can absolutely process that return for you. We want to make sure every rider has gear they love, as proper fit and comfort are key to safety.

That's great news, thank you. I do have one small question. Since I'll be paying for the return shipping and plan to buy the correct color helmet from you, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10% to offset the shipping cost?

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you're planning to stick with VeloFit for your next helmet. Unfortunately, our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns of this nature. However, I can get the return authorization started for you right now so you can get your refund as quickly as possible.
Alright, I understand. Can't blame a guy for trying. Let's go ahead with the return process then.

Of course. I've just sent the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
